Candidate probe loads the saved actual statistical DLL and checks identical original PNG input and all output samples. Both JIT pre/post quiet checks pass; no timing or component-attribution claim.

limitations: PNG16 short/repeat mean ratios 1.95194x / 1.94868x; short upper 2.18366x, 12-sample upper 1.96259x. PNG8 has one affected 12-sample screen at 1.81202x, upper 1.82584x. Formal independent passing confirmation remains open.
Both statistical prequiet checks pass and postquiet checks fail; original failures and passing/failing cooldowns are retained. JIT checks pass both quiet samples.

No algorithm, work/cancellation ordering, lookahead/refill/cursor, grammar/checksum/output/memory admission, precision, hidden RGB or ownership changes. The performance evidence covers only the selected two original cases on the dedicated VM.

Other PNG profiles, required codec/editing paths and independent quiet passing confirmation remain open. All retained measured point estimates are now under 2x; that does not establish uniform coverage or parity. Next, measure one material uncovered path and rerank.
